description: This file defines a Sass (SCSS) mixin library for responsive font sizing based on the RFS (Responsive Font Sizes) approach, including configuration variables, mixins for dynamic font size adjustment, media queries activation, and compatibility adjustments.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: A mixin that calculates and applies a responsive font size based on input size and configuration variables.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: A wrapper mixin that uses the rfs mixin to set font size with optional important flag.

methods.name: responsive-font-size
methods.description: Aliased wrapper for font-size, providing a more descriptive name for responsive font sizing.
